Pros
No time pressure
No pressure to kids for irregular attendance
Food provided is satisfactory for my child
Kids sleep time is maintained between 1 to 4 pm
In free time, kids play in the school so no worries
Friendly environment
Monthly payments acceptable
My kid is diaper free at least 80 percent now during daytime
Provides actual home like environment for kids so they learn how actually and practically to live in house or outside world
We feel the center gives more  personal attention against what some big schools offer.
The play area is outside and hence we feel that the kids get fresh air.

Cons
Location changed from Tanishq LT road, Borivali west to Vazira naka, Borivali west.
Transportation available but still not convinced or comfortable to send small kids in a van, but this is not the school 's fault.
Will appreciate if more cars/scooters toys are made available to kids now, that the play area is big and outside.
